notes: Pay, exact ages and the next application window are not on the page, so call or email the office. Follow @mycboston on Instagram.
name: Boston Mayor's Youth Council
org: Office of Youth Engagement and Advancement, City of Boston
what_you_do: Youth Councilors speak for Boston youth in city government and lead their own projects. The 2025-26 council's Streets Committee made a guide for residents requesting ramps and sidewalks.
who_can_apply: Boston youth. The page does not list an age or grade rule.
duration: A yearly cohort (the 2025-26 cohort was announced in December 2025)
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The page has an Interest Form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Interest Form on the Mayor's Youth Council page. Questions: 617-961-6980 or 1481 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02120.
